args.code: (() => { const row = document.querySelectorAll('.dsb-row-anchor')[0]; const btns = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button')).map(b => b.className + '|' + (b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')); const info = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => !b.classList.contains('dsb-row-check')); if (!info) return JSON.stringify({err:'no info btn', btns}); info.click(); const pressed = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dsb-row-check')).map(b => b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')); const popover = !!document.querySelector('[role=dialog], [data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]'); return JSON.stringify({btns, pressed, popover}); })()
